1.name: Wyatt Sicks
1.collective_archetype: Chthonic cult-of-the-dead / mystery-cult (DISBANDED AS A UNIT)
1.internal_roles: All members released 2026-04-24: Howdy/Bo Dallas, Rowan, Lumis, Gacy. Cross already departed.
1.notes: **WWE released the entire faction together in the post-WM42 purge. The unit was expelled as a unit.** Joe's load-bearing read (2026-04-25, preserved verbatim): *"this story will be told, I don't think they will collectively go to a different place, the fact that they were released together as a whole tells us everything."* Released-as-a-whole = unit-that-returns. The corporate logic (generational reset, every released main-roster talent except 3 is 35+, youth push around Oba/Je'Von/Sol Ruca) collides with the symbolic register: a faction whose entire purpose was Bo Dallas making his brother Bray's death visible through kayfabe was terminated mid-ritual, the week after the company's high-magic moment. Corrective vs Descriptive layers active in the same event. Tag titles 196 days, lost to MFTs 1/23/26. **DEFERRED for Worked Shoot scroll work** — Joe's call: do not pull into 4/30 False Heir thread, let it settle into the unconscious register. Watch: do they collectively resurface (AEW, indie, new project), or scatter? See worked-shoot-wyatt-sicks-dissolution.md (memory) for full read.

2.name: Judgment Day
2.collective_archetype: Dark-feminine coven fronted by a corrupt prince
2.internal_roles: Dom=corrupt prince (Dumuzi-awaiting-substitute-payment), Liv=Inanna/Lilith-carrier, Raquel=warrior-matron, Roxanne=prodigal, JD=weak-link/hatchetman
2.notes: Bálor expelled 3/9/26. **Raw 5/18**: WWE production graphic **visually confirmed** faction's female identity shift (institutional-authority statement at production layer). JD women = coven fully operational. Dom = "last holdout" per Joe — mythologically REQUIRED to stay until Liv casts him out as substitute payment (Inanna myth). **Raw 5/18**: JD women lost Women's Tag challenge to Paige/Brie (interference ejected, quick-turnaround win). Lyra+Bayley save post-match. Inanna-pacing PROTECTED — booking is holding back the substitute-payment beat. McDonagh exposed as weak link (lost street fight 2-on-1 to Bálor despite Dom's assist).

3.name: The MFTs (formerly Bloodline)
3.notes: **SD 4/25**: Faction destroyed by Fatu in one episode. Fatu declared for Raw. **SD 5/08**: Solo demoted to manager-architect of Tama/Talla remnant. **Tonga Loa + JC Mateo RELEASED** — remnant = Solo + Tama + Talla only. **SD 5/15**: Solo ran three-axis revenge (vs Priest: Samoan Spike post-match; vs Nakamura: Talla backstage beatdown through table; vs Keys: chair-slide at ringside cost Keys #1 contender match). Tama passive/contemplative throughout; Talla externalizes enforcement. **Tama vs Nakamura booked SD 5/22** — the brother-as-hold dynamic gets tested in-ring. Solo-Keys consolation feud set up.

4.name: American Made
4.notes: Olympus-as-fascist-aesthetic. **El Grande Americano feud RESOLVED at Noche 5/30: Gable lost Mask vs Mask to Kaiser and unmasked** — Kaiser kept the mask and the unqualified name. Gable conceded honorably; "Shorty G." return + face-rub seeded.

5.name: Fatal Influence
5.notes: **Called up from NXT 4/25/26.** Two DQs in one night on debut SmackDown. Can't win clean, can prevent clean nights. Interfered in Paige/Brie vs Charlotte/Alexa (DQ) and Rhea vs Jacy (DQ). Announced "taking over SmackDown." Three-women stable ≠ automatic Furies — numbers-based disruption is their main-roster identity. **Reid confirmed as third member** — SD 5/22 (tagged with Henley vs Rhea/Charlotte, lost).

6.name: Street Profits
6.notes: Tag title challengers vs Vision. **Raw 5/11**: Knoxville — Ford's meta-kayfabe promo in Bianca's hometown. Won 3v3 (w/ Hendry) vs Vision. Post-match: Seth saved them, Ford resented it. **Raw 5/18**: Dawkins saved Seth (first Ragnarok recruit); Ford followed reluctantly. **SNME 5/23**: Lost World Tag Title match — triple-interference dirty finish. Post-match: Breakker speared both. Rift starts from shared humiliation, not betrayal. Year-long slow burn ahead.

7.name: Irresistible Forces
7.notes: Nia Jax + Lash Legend. **SNME 5/23**: Lost Women's Tag Title match to Paige/Brie (sunset flip w/ leverage). Nia's immovable-mass register active — isolated Paige with power moves (Samoan drop, rear chin lock). The earth-mother tag team: one is the ground, the other is what grows from it.

8.name: Secret Hervice
8.notes: Camp-state-power parody. Two original members hurt (Green ankle, Niven neck), and the witch-champion who was carrying TV time solo has been released. The mock-court has no functional members on TV. Faction status TBD pending Green/Niven returns.

9.name: Los Americanos
9.collective_archetype: Masked-imposter cell / the mask made sacred
9.internal_roles: Kaiser=*único* El Grande Americano (folk-hero apex), Rayo=Dunne, Bravo=Bate
9.notes: European wrestlers in lucha masks as American-coded heels. **Noche de Los Grandes 5/30: Kaiser WON Mask vs Mask, KEPT his mask, unmasked Gable** — and took the unqualified name "El Grande Americano" (Gable, the creator, was the "Original/OG" asterisk). The German who played the gimmick straight (learned the language, honored the tradition) became the one Monterrey claimed (mural: "un mexicano nace donde le da la chingada gana"). **The mask built to mock became the mask the crowd made real** — the inclusion-light pole of the Scroll-007 duality.

10.name: Jade's Faction (unnamed)
10.notes: **SD 5/15**: Faction confirmed (Jade + Michin + B-Fab). NOT "Fatal Influence" (that's Jacy/Fallon). Formal naming deferred. Jade declared Women's Championship hers at Clash in Italy. Mocked Charlotte/Bliss as "backup dancers." **SNME 5/23**: Six-woman tag vs Rhea/Charlotte/Bliss.

11.name: Kabuki Warriors (+IYO orbit)
11.notes: Triangulation collapsed to binary (Asuka vs IYO); binary resolved at Backlash — IYO won the senpai-kōhai send-off. Asuka's post-Backlash direction unclear. IYO now fully solo.

12.name: LWO
12.notes: Archetype hibernating. Group lives on as entrance music. Santos Escobar left.

13.name: DarkState
13.notes: **NXT 5/19**: Lost NXT Tag title match to Vanity Project. Post-match: **Lennox turned on Shugars** — triple powerbomb through announce desk. Faction implosion.

15.name: Meta-Four
15.notes: Dar=ringleader, Mensah=lieutenant, Jackson=enforcer. Lash Legend called up to main roster (Irresistible Forces w/ Nia Jax).

16.name: No Quarter Catch Crew
16.notes: Dempsey=headmaster. Members keep leaving by defeating him. Vessel leaking.

17.name: Birthright
17.notes: Lexis King + Charlie Dempsey + Stacks. Father's-unfinished-business as origin story.

18.name: Death Riders
18.internal_roles: Moxley=hellrider-prophet, Castagnoli=enforcer-zealot, Yuta=convert, PAC=war-priest, Shafir=warrior-shadow, Garcia=defector-trophy
18.notes: NOT chthonic-cult-of-the-dead (Wyatt Sicks) — the Death Riders bring death, not commune with the dead. The BCC's "real wrestling" club hijacked into a death-cult — the hijacking IS the archetypal point. Theological opposite of the Conglomeration. Moxley = Continental Champion.

19.name: Don Callis Family
19.internal_roles: Callis=consigliere-Cardinal, Takeshita=heir (NJPW TV Champ), Fletcher=princeling (injured), Okada=imported royalty, Hechicero=nahual, Andrade=grandee, + ~10 shock troops
19.notes: 16+ members. Faction as roster-within-a-roster. Patronage structure, not brotherhood — recruits across promotions and continents. Takeshita-Okada split at DON 5/24 = staged murder. Watch mid-2026 for pruning.

20.name: Hurt Syndicate
20.internal_roles: Lashley=All-Mighty general (cross-ref WWE Departed), Benjamin=Standard-of-Excellence, MVP=consigliere
20.notes: Discipline, not chaos. Closer to military-academy than mob. Searching for 4th. Allied with Jericho 4/25 vs The Demand. Reactivated from WWE's Hurt Business (2020-21) — lineage refusing to die when the original company dispersed it.

21.name: The Opps
21.notes: Silence, technique, threat. Bowens (flamboyant, scissors) joining a deadpan trio = archetype-stretch test. **Framework note**: with Wyatt Sicks dissolved 4/24/26, the Opps carry the closest corrective-resistance archetype across both major American promotions. Mantle migration in the same week — three agents converged independently.

22.name: The Conglomeration
22.internal_roles: Cassidy=ironic patriarch, O'Reilly=artisan, Strong=defector, + Briscoe/Ishii/Hologram (injured), Willow
22.notes: Trios Champs (Dynasty 4/12). Wrestling itself loving wrestling. Theological opposite of Death Riders. Three of seven injured. Greater-than-sum decisively.

23.name: The Matriarchy
23.internal_roles: Mother Wayne=matriarch/power center, Nick Wayne=puppet-king (ROH TV Champ), Sabian=enforcer (injured), Killswitch=retainer
23.notes: Cleanest live archetypal transformation 2025-26: The Patriarchy deposed by mother + son, renamed. Completes the inversion that WWE's Judgment Day only telegraphs (Dom still fronts JD; here the father is expelled and the mother rules through the son).

24.name: Triangle of Madness
24.internal_roles: Thekla=Arachne (AEW Women's World Champ), Hart=ex-priestess (HoB lineage), Blue=trickster-shadow
24.notes: DA-reconciled: Thekla = Arachne individually, trio = the web. Not Hecate's three faces (requires three aspects of one woman, not three different women). Each woman carries her own prior myth into the trio. Triangle = geometrically strongest stable shape.

25.name: The Demand
25.internal_roles: Ricochet=lighter-than-air collector, Toa Liona + Bishop Kaun=titan-enforcers (ex-Gates of Agony)
25.notes: One-fast + two-titans = mercenary geometry. Beat Hurt Syndicate at All Out 2025. Pinned Jericho twice (4/18, 4/25). They show up because something is owed.

26.name: Hounds of Hell
26.notes: Renamed from House of Black (Jan 2025, Malakai out). DA-reconciled: Cerberus claim is trademark filing, not on-screen content. King solo = individual chthonic-warrior. Third-head archetype hibernating inside the stable.

27.name: The Dogs
27.internal_roles: Finlay=alpha (Bullet Club lineage), Connors=American bull, Kidd=mad-dog (injured)
27.notes: Signed AEW March 2026. Won/lost Trios in four days. NJPW War Dogs imported intact. Not Death Riders (apocalyptic), not Hounds (chthonic) — Hobbesian: nasty, brutish, short.

28.name: United Empire (AEW)
28.internal_roles: Ospreay=emperor, Andrade=consort-knight, + NJPW imports (Newman, HENARE, Akira)
28.notes: Ospreay reactivated UE to fight Death Riders. The empire that abandoned its homeland to defend its emperor on foreign soil. Booking-dependent: watch whether AEW-side members get permanent storylines.

29.name: The Elite
29.notes: Reunited Nov 2025. Beat Don Callis Family at Dynasty. AEW founding stable's archetype reactivated. Reads more tag-trio than Pantheon collective.

30.name: LFI (La Facción Ingobernable)
30.notes: Post-2014 CMLL-Ingobernables tradition imported intact. Both Rush and Dralistico returned from injury. Weaker than 2024 peak; rebuilding.

31.name: Bang Bang Gang
31.internal_roles: White=injured, Robinson + Gunns + Ace Austin carrying
31.notes: Was Pantheon-tier in 2024; now hibernating-by-injury. "Stand-alone unit" after NJPW Bullet Club merged into Unbound Co.

32.name: Divine Dominion
32.notes: Women's Tag Champs since Revolution 2026. Two queens too big for any single throne — together they domain-rule by coverage. Exceeds the sum: together they suggest a species of women not visible elsewhere on the card.

current_titles.title: AEW Women's World Tag Team Championship

33.name: The System
33.notes: NOT "heel stable" — Goodfellas as wrestling structure. Capo took power by violent internal swerve (low-blowing JDC Jan '26), inducting muscle through ritual humiliation. Eddie's "Becoming World Champion would set the tone for The System" = mafia-promotion language.

34.name: Order 4
34.notes: Clerical-disciplinary archetype rare in modern wrestling. "Order 4" evokes religious order. NOT Muslim-coded heel — the Inquisitor archetype is available in many traditions. Won International title at Rebellion via classic faction-interference.

35.name: The Hardys
35.notes: Broken-universe lineage since 2016 = the American-wrestling occult-vessel set. Lost 265-day Tag reign at Rebellion to The System.

36.name: The Righteous
36.notes: Signed Jan 17 '26. "Can The Righteous BREAK Matt Hardy" (Apr 23) = gothic-pulpit-vs-broken-oracle. Lost stip match to Matt 4/23.

37.name: Elegance Brand
37.internal_roles: Ash=architect, Heather+M=court-champions, Concierge=ferryman-butler, Mr. Elegance=kept warrior
37.notes: Heiress's curated-court: female champions, male butler, male in-ring champion serving the women. DA: Restoration-period literary referent over Pasiphaë — the configuration is specifically early-modern-aristocratic, not mythological. Won Hardcore Country match at Rebellion.

38.name: Undead Realm / Decay
38.internal_roles: Rosemary=officiant, Allie=returned, Crazzy Steve=Wrath-jester, Abyss=creature, Mitchell=priest, Mara Sadè=TBD
38.notes: Unique in 2026 wrestling: literal necromancy storyline as primary thread. Seven-sins ritual reassembling original 2016 Decay in real-time. Scroll-eligible as complete-ritual-as-faction case study. Abyss return April '26 = shocking cliffhanger.

39.name: First Class
39.notes: "Rich-snob" faction. Not a major title player in '26 but durable.

40.name: Diamond Collective
40.notes: Minimal storyline weight as of Rebellion. Tessa-as-Cassandra operative if/when faction lands. Verify: listed on roster sites but near-zero footage.

41.name: Unbound Co.
41.internal_roles: Tsuji=daimyō, Shingo=elder-warrior, Knockout Bros=tag-arm, Ishimori+Robbie X=junior-arm, Moloney=foreign-loyalist, Gedo=manager
41.notes: Post-Bullet Club inversion. Founded Jan 5 2026 via merger of Unaffiliated (LIJ residual) + War Dogs (BC sub-faction). Former gaijin-outlaw stable now subordinate to a Japanese ace — Sengoku-period realignment. Lost Finlay, Connors, Kidd to AEW Feb-Mar '26.

42.name: House of Torture
42.notes: Transformed Jan '26 by EVIL departure → Narita succession. Shifted from personal-darkness-cult (EVIL) to institutional-corruption-cult (Narita). DA: corrupted-bushido, not occult-evil. Togo as actual booker + on-screen lieutenant = puppetmaster-uchikobashi.

43.name: United Empire
43.internal_roles: Newman=young-prince/IWGP Champion, Ospreay=returning-mentor, HENARE=Maori-warrior (colonial question), O-Khan=Mongol-claimant, Andrade=Mexican affiliate, Jake Lee=ronin, Akira=Italian junior, Zane Jay=apprentice
43.notes: DA: British-imperial-as-character leads over Yamato-Takeru-retinue. HENARE positioned as the colonized warrior whose loyalty is the storyline question. Newman's coronation Apr 4 reframed the stable from "post-Ospreay husk" to champion-holding unit.

44.name: TMDK
44.notes: Brotherhood organized around technique (submission grappling), not charismatic individual or national identity. Cross-promotional (ROH/AEW/NOAH). Distinct from UE's conquest-retinue: TMDK is technique-monastery.

45.name: Don Callis Family (NJPW)
45.notes: Sengoku-era mercenary-band pledging to whichever warlord pays best. Callis: manages it "like Tony Khan's sports franchises." NOT personality-cult. Inside NJPW, Takeshita carries the TV title as the syndicate's flag-bearer-in-Japan.

46.name: Hontai
46.internal_roles: Goto=Bishamonten-elder, Ishii=Raijin, Wolf=Tengu, Boltin=steppe-warrior, Yano=Sacred Clown, Taichi=ronin-elder, Umino+Uemura=Ace-candidates, Desperado/Wato/Kushida/YOH=junior arm
46.notes: Absorbed CHAOS March '25 members, now larger and more amorphous than ever. Practical leadership rotating among Goto/Bishamon, Uemura, Ishii. Setup for internal Hontai split — pattern repeated 3x since 2014. G1 35 is the watch.

47.name: Bullet Club
47.notes: 13-year run ended. Tsuji on the mic — voluntary-symbol-release = integration, not repression. Foreign-outlaw archetype currently hibernating.

48.name: LIJ
48.internal_roles: Naito departed May '25 with BUSHI; final match June '25
48.notes: Tranquilo-trickster-king archetype unheld in NJPW. Naito performing internationally. Archetype may resurface distorted.

49.name: CHAOS
49.notes: 16-year unit absorbed into Hontai. Pirate-merchant-chaos collective archetype hibernating. Watch for internal Hontai split to revive the slot.

50.name: Las Toxicas
50.internal_roles: Flammer=Coatlicue queen, La Hiedra=Mayahuel-venom, Lady Maravilla=Tlazolteotl-rudo
50.notes: 974-day reign IS the faction's defense statement. Trio older than the WWE acquisition. Cleanest occluded-feminine collective in any current promotion.

51.name: Los Vipers
51.internal_roles: Abismo Negro Jr.=leader (inherited mask), Taurus=enforcer, Histeria=trickster
51.notes: Reformed lineage of original 2000s Vipers. Serpent/abyss/storm vocabulary consistent with Mictlan (Aztec underworld) iconography.

52.name: Los Psycho Circus
52.internal_roles: Psycho Clown + Monster Clown + Murder Clown
52.notes: Clown-trinity in lucha = sacred-clown / carnival-mask, not Western circus. Same vessel (Psycho Clown) runs parallel archetypes across tag + trios. **The Psycho-Circus mystery-attacker storyline (clowns hospitalized) paid off at Noche 5/30: Pagano = the mastermind**, betraying Psycho Clown after their tag-title loss. Intra-cult fracture; Psycho's revenge arc opens → 6/6.

53.name: Aztec Warriors
53.internal_roles: Octagón Jr. + Laredo Kid (sometimes Aero Star, Mr. Iguana)
53.notes: Hero-Twin frame from Maya creation epic — defeat the lords of Xibalba. Cleanest archetypal grouping for any Mexican masked-warrior pair.

54.name: Tokyo Bad Boys
54.notes: DA: gokudō/outlaw-warrior over yakuza (specific criminal org vs structural archetype). Long lucha tradition: Japanese-rudo-in-Mexico lineage from Gran Hamada / Black Tiger forward.

55.name: Contra Unit
55.collective_archetype: Sports-terror cult / the devourer that eats outward and inward
55.internal_roles: Kushida=new blade, Okumura=quiet hand, Krueger=severed Black Hand (expelled)
55.notes: "Self-described originators of sports terrorism," 5+ years. Same-night construction 6/6: absorb a champion (Kushida reveal-as-ambush) while a video package shows the destruction of their own former centerpiece — recruitment and cannibalism as a single statement.

56.name: The Skyscrapers
56.notes: MLW World Tag Team Champions since June 2025. "Still the team of MLW's tag division." Survived the Good Brothers' double-tables challenge 6/6; the post-match brawl outlived the broadcast.

57.name: Good Brothers
57.collective_archetype: Journeymen-Kings / eight crowns abroad, none at home
57.notes: 8x world tag champions (US/Japan); chasing #9 in MLW. The "world famous" self-billing carried with genuine credentials — face-coded by effort in defeat.

58.name: Gallus
58.notes: MLW tag debut 5/30 (Coffeys lost to Good Brothers, champions watching from commentary). Third credible pack circling the tag belts. Ex-WWE/NXT diaspora intact as a unit.

59.name: SENTAI Death Squad
59.notes: Official-roster seed (mlw.com); not yet observed on relaunch TV.

60.name: Los Aztecas
60.notes: Official-roster seed; not yet observed on relaunch TV. Cross-references the AAA Aztec Warriors frame — same source mythology, different promotion.
